text:
Alex G: Late-shift handoff: I'm out in ~15. Quick coverage notes and known noisy signals.

Alex G: Watchlist (non-incidents):
- prefix-cache TTL alerts: noisy around 03:10-03:40 UTC (flapping on stalling invalidates). Suppressed by rule `ttl-noise-suppress-v2` but monitor.
- eu-encoder pool: encoder-pool-3 showing intermittent emitter dropouts (info-level, increased retries). Tracking ticket INFR-1861.
- kv-prefetch jitter: small tail-latency spikes when bursty replay hits cold prefixes.

Alex G: Runbooks/quick ops:
- Check encoder health: `kubectl get pods -l app=encoder -o wide --namespace inference-eu` then `curl http://encoder-pool-3/health`.
- TTL suppression: `redctl alerts mute prefix-cache ttl-noise-suppress-v2 --until 2026-03-19T08:00Z` (already applied)
- If emitter drops exceed 5m continuous -> scale pool to +1 and open a debug pod: see runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/encoder-pool

Marie K: Noted. Can you post the grafana panel links for the encoder drops and prefix TTL so I can watch while onshift?

Alex G: Sure:
- encoder drops: https://grafana.redwood/r/encoders/encoder-pool-3
- prefix-ttl: https://grafana.redwood/r/cache/prefix-ttl

Dinesh P: I'll take primary for the next 2 hours. If encoder-pool-3 shows >3 drop events in 10m, I'll escalate and start the scale and debug pod flow. :thumbsup:

Jess L: FYI earlier at 03:12 we saw a 12s tail on kv-prefetch for a small batch (trace id 0x9f3a). I captured logs and attached to INFR-1861.

Marie K: Thanks. Quick check — are we still routing EU traffic to fallback model when pool degrades? I don't want noisy failovers to trigger customer-facing errors.

Alex G: Yes — smart-routing fallback is enabled for eu by policy `fallback-eu-low-latency`. If you see increased reroute rates, notify me or Dinesh and we'll flip to canary-fallback mode.

oncall-bot: Reminder: shift coverage rotation — Dinesh P is primary until 2472124756. Please update the handoff card if you change coverage.

Dinesh P: Will update the handoff card. If anyone is oncall backup later, ping me in this thread before 04:30.

Marie K: I'll monitor prefix-cache panel and mute noisy alerts if they spike again; will leave notes here.

Alex G: Thanks team. Leaving logs and runbook links in the handoff card. Back tomorrow AM. :wave:
